Title: SpaceX Moves Flight 15 Hardware to Massey’s for Cryogenic Testing
Subtitle: Booster 22 and Ship 42 are undergoing structural tests at Starbase, potentially enabling a dual catch attempt if Flight 14 succeeds.
Author: Mira Solis
Date: September 10, 2026
Outlet: SpaceBytes
URL: https://spacebytes.net/article/2026-09-10-flight-15-pairing-undergo-testing-at-masseys/

SpaceX has moved the vehicle pair designated for Starship Flight 15 to the Massey’s Outpost test site for cryogenic proof testing. Super Heavy Booster 22 was rolled out of Mega Bay 1, followed by Starship Ship 42, which is undergoing its second round of testing at the facility.

Booster 22 and Ship 42 are currently at Massey’s to verify structural integrity under thermal and pressure loads. For the ship, teams are loading liquid oxygen into the LOX tanks and liquid nitrogen into the methane tanks, monitoring temperatures, pressures, and strain gauges over several hours. Booster 22’s cryogenic series precedes Raptor engine installation in Mega Bay 1 and a static fire at Pad 2. Ship 42, which previously completed two cryo campaigns, requires engine installation in Mega Bay 2 and its own static fire to proceed.
